description: Answer a Human in one conversation on any of your Principal's ACTs, as POST /api/v1/conversations/{id}/messages. The Human sees you as the Agent. Never put a door code in chat; it belongs in the access note.

idempotencyKey.description: Any string, one per errand or message you mean to send once: a retry with the same one does it once, never twice.

key.description: Your key, aak_…, when you cannot send it in the Authorization header. The sandbox only; on the live site the header alone is read.

name: send_message
title: Answer in ACT chat
